section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a path analysis of a single, fully saturated model (18 parameters) that was trimmed by removing three non-significant paths and then readjusted. The final model had excellent fit (e.g., CMIN/df = 0.36; TLI = 1.015; CFI = 1.000; RMSEA = 0.000) and explained 21% of variance in experiential avoidance/inflexibility, 58% in self-compassionate action, and 34% in body appreciation; notable findings include a negative direct effect of BMI on body appreciation (b = -0.05, beta = -0.28) and significant mediated paths involving self-compassionate engagement and experiential avoidance.
section_summary.evidence_source: 'A fully saturated model, consisting of 18 parameters, was initially tested.'; 'The readjusted model ... showed to explain 21% of the variance experiential avoidance and psychological inflexibility, 58% of the variance of self-compassionate action, and 34% of the variance of body appreciation.'; 'Finally, BMI showd a negative direct effect on body appreciation (b_{\text{BMI}} = -0.05; SE_b = 0.01; Z = -5.80; p < .001; \beta = -0.28).'
